## 👋 Welcome Conversational AI (Part 2)

## PART 2: DESIGNING FOR SUCCESS

## Week 3: Designing Effective Processes (Chapter 3)

### Slide 1: Target Selection Strategy

- **The Sweet Spot**: Target high-frequency, low-complexity incoming requests for initial automation.
- **Complexity Metrics**: Number of decision paths, system integrations, and regulatory boundary edge-cases.
- **Process Mapping**: Convert legacy human call-center scripts into deterministic flowchart logic trees.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A[Incoming Request] --> B{High Frequency?}
    B -- No --> C[Keep Human-Assisted]
    B -- Yes --> D{Low Complexity?}
    D -- No --> E[Phase 2/3 Automation]
    D -- Yes --> F[Automate First]
    F --> G[Measure KPI Impact]
```

### Slide 2: Cross-Functional Team Roles

- **Product Owner / Business Lead**: Defines KPIs, ROI expectations, and process boundaries.
- **Conversation Designer**: Writes natural dialogue paths, persona guidelines, and fallback flows.
- **NLU/AI Trainer**: Collects data, labels utterances, resolves intent collisions, and trains models.
- **Software Engineer**: Manages API webhooks, database state persistence, and continuous integration pipelines.

![](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1521737604893-d14cc237f11d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80){fig-alt="Cross-functional team collaboration" height="360px"}

### Slide 3: Channel Dynamics — Web/Text vs. Voice

| Feature | Web / Text (Chatbots) | Voice (IVR / Telephony) |
|---|---|---|
| **Pacing** | User-controlled, visual scanning | Real-time audio stream, sequential memory load |
| **Interface Options** | Buttons, carousels, rich text, links | Pure voice, keypad inputs (DTMF) |
| **Error Rate** | Low (precise spelling/clicking) | High (background noise, accents, ASR errors) |
| **Brevity** | Paragraphs supported | Strictly 1–2 sentence turns |

## Week 4: Designing Effective Dialogue (Chapter 4)

### Slide 1: Persona and Brand Tone

- **Persona Definition**: Define explicit attributes (e.g., professional, concise, empathetic) without pretending to be human.
- **Variations in Response**: Rotate templates to avoid repetitive output (e.g., *"Got it"*, *"Sure thing"*, *"Understood"*).
- **Setting Expectations**: Explicitly declare capabilities during the initial turn.

![](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1454165804606-c3d57bc86b40?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80){fig-alt="Brand voice and communication planning" height="340px"}

### Slide 2: Question & Disambiguation Design

- **Open vs. Closed Prompts**:
  - *Open*: *"How can I help you today?"* (high NLU flexibility required)
  - *Closed*: *"Did you want to check your balance or pay a bill?"* (constrained responses)
- **Implicit vs. Explicit Acknowledgments**:
  - *Implicit*: *"Sure, let's update your address. What is your new zip code?"*
  - *Explicit*: *"Did you say you want to change your primary home address?"*

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    U[User Input] --> I{Intent Clear?}
    I -- Yes --> A[Implicit Ack + Next Slot]
    I -- No --> E[Explicit Confirmation]
    E --> U2[User Clarifies]
    U2 --> A
```

### Slide 3: Designing Graceful Failure Recovery

- **Targeted Reprompts**: Explain *how* to rephrase instead of repeating *"I didn't understand that."*
- **Context Preservation**: Keep collected entities while requesting missing information.
- **Escalation Path**: Pass gathered variables and transcript context during live-agent handoff.

## Week 5: Building a Successful AI Assistant (Chapter 5)

### Slide 1: Telemetry and Event Logging

- **Data Logging**: Record every utterance, confidence score, intent, entities, path executed, and session duration.
- **Session Tracking**: Map user flows from start to end state using unique session IDs.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    S[Session Start] --> U[User Utterance]
    U --> N[NLU Output: Intent + Entities + Confidence]
    N --> P[Dialogue Policy Path]
    P --> R[Response Sent]
    R --> M[Metrics Store / Dashboard]
```

### Slide 2: Core Assistant Metrics

$$
	ext{Containment Rate} = \frac{\text{Sessions Resolved Without Human Escalation}}{\text{Total Incoming Sessions}}
$$

- **Containment Rate**: Percentage of users who complete goals entirely within the AI assistant.
- **Time to Resolution (TTR)**: Average elapsed seconds from initiation to successful completion.
- **Coverage**: Percentage of inbound traffic mapped to actionable intents vs. fallback.
- **NPS / CSAT**: Satisfaction from post-interaction micro-surveys.

![](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551281044-8b7e32d9f0f6?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=80){fig-alt="Analytics dashboard for AI assistant metrics" height="320px"}
